asr.full_text: Introduction First things that we discussed is what is the cryptocurrency, and what is blockchain. Once you understand the basics, then we switch to litecoin overview. This litecoin overview chapter discusseses what really is litecoin, and sums up all the details in 1 lecture that shows you the way ahead, then we discussed who is litecoin then we discussed litecoin technical overview the first lectures open-source software and what is the proof of work for litecoin and how do transaction occur in Litecoin? These are the all technical chapters so they give you a detailed overview of what really happens in litecoin transaction. Then, we discussed Litecoin over Bitcoin. Will Litecoin overrun Bitcoin, that's an important question. And, the difference between Litecoins and Bitcoin and why is Litecoins rising and the total number of Litecoins in circulation or the total number of Litecoins that will be in circulation in future that will be capped cap means no more lag winds will be generated so its supply will be limited then we discussed litecoin mining and technical details of litecoin mining and the mining reward and the litecoin mining forum which will help you in like uh... updating your software or about the future updates or how you can like maximise your profit in mining and all those stuff then we discuss litecoin wallet's overview litecoin wallets , litecoin wallet part 2 how to make your wallets more secure , An important chapter And Litecoin Wallet demo Then we discussed How to buy or sell Litecoin. The first website that we discussed was Litecoin.net And litecoinlocal.demo How to buy or sell Litecoin through Coinbase And Kraken And another important forum Litecoin price forum which will help you understand why the price is rising what's the news behind it. Basically is news forum. Then we discussed what is a faucet and how to earn Litecoin for FREE that's the best part and the most important chapter of all we discussed Litecoin on charts. The first thing is support and resistance you will know in this chapter what is the real support and resistance right now what's really is happening where it will take a support and rise up or where it can like have resistance. Then we discussed Litecoin trendlines. What are the trendlines saying for the long-term trend? And Litecoin Fibonacci Retracement. It tells you what are the real levels, real targets, that can be achieved easily. And Litecoin on Charts. An overview of what I believe is happening in the market and will happen in the future and I will keep on updating a future lecture per month so that I can give you a monthly update on what is happening and if there is something wrong in the market then what you should do. And then the bonus lecture that is all my discounted courses. you can buy it cheaper than yudimi and you can enjoy those courses thank you
